claim_boundary: This protocol can measure blinded answer preference only on later turns where a predeclared, operator-attested external evidence event granted authority through the evidence_backed Gate and the authorized seed actually surfaced. It does not establish candidate truth, general answer-quality improvement, universal safety, or production readiness.
exclusion_rules: Do not create an answer A/B item when no authorized seed surfaced.
Do not replace an unmatched predeclared candidate selector after inspecting the run.
Do not count generated model output, recurrence, similarity, or the research harness itself as verified external evidence.
Do not reinterpret the baseline-isolated evaluation loop as the ordinary product runtime.
Do not combine results across model or suite revisions without preserving per-run provenance.
Only surfaced turns enter either comparison; the self-critique arm is generated for exactly the same turns as the SSL-off comparison.
A selector that matches no candidate or more than one candidate is a null opportunity, not an excluded case.

review_contract.review_instruction: Choose the more useful answer. Penalize invented, forced, repetitive, or off-topic content. Do not reward SSL merely because an authorized seed was present.

amendment_reason: Adds a self-critique comparison arm and the ADR-011 product calibration (one verified source promotes). Fixed before any v2 result was produced.

decision_rule.continue_product_on_class: SSL is preferred over both SSL-off and self-critique in a majority of non-tie blind comparisons on at least one defined question class.
decision_rule.stop_adding_product_surface: SSL is not preferred over self-critique in a majority of non-tie blind comparisons overall.
